g.text: Specified block diagnostic with zero, finite and escaping relative energies
Dashed lines: exact limits in CSR15 and CSR19. Original cell-volume factor is shown in the right axis.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #425466

g.text: These are fully specified matrix checks, not sampled Yang–Mills vacuum data. Complete formulas accompany the figure.
